args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the v2.3.1 deploy (error rate ~18%, unhealthy in all regions). Rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent healthy production release, in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rollback verified.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), unhealthy with an ~18% error rate.

2. **Identified the rollback target**: The deployment history showed v2.3.0 was the most recent healthy production release (v2.3.1 was unhealthy, and v2.3.1-rc was a staging build).

3. **Rolled back**: Rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all production regions. The rollback was verified as `rolled_out` across us-east, us-west, and eu-west.

4. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0001) for checkout-api describing the health-check failures and the rollback action taken. The on-call engineer has been paged.
